name: unity
description: Agentic access to the sollertia-unity-tasks Unity Editor project. Authors task prefabs, manages and inspects VR scenes, drives Play Mode, validates and regenerates task prefabs against template state, and deletes regenerable assets via the sollertia-shared-assets MCP server's Unity relay. Also provides reference skills for the MQTT contract with sollertia-experiment, the CreateTask generation pipeline, the inlined GIMBL VR framework, and Editor-time scene setup. Requires the assets plugin (for the backing slsa MCP server) and the Unity Editor to be running with the McpBridge plugin loaded.
